fullPassage:
AI is a prolific idea generator. Human brainstorming groups tend to focus on the quality of creative ideas and almost immediately lean into variations of first suggestions, but good ideas are more likely when groups focus first on quantity. As Linus Pauling put it, "The best way to have a good idea is to have lots of ideas." Psychologist Dean Keith Simonton called this the "equal odds rule" arguing that creative success is correlated to the total number of works created. Many studies have confirmed that creative quality comes from quantity of ideas (what Bob Sutton at a design and innovation consulting company called "idea ratio"), and one Stanford study pegged the number of ideas that distinguish a successful product from a failure at more than two thousand. This is why design thinking and innovation are so focused on the processes (what Utley and Klebahn call "idea flow") of ____________________.

* prolific: 많이 만들어 내는, 다작의 ** peg: 못박다

questions.passage:
AI is a prolific idea generator.

(A) Psychologist Dean Keith Simonton called this the "equal odds rule" arguing that creative success is correlated to the total number of works created.
(B) Human brainstorming groups tend to focus on the quality of creative ideas and almost immediately lean into variations of first suggestions, but good ideas are more likely when groups focus first on quantity.
(C) Many studies have confirmed that creative quality comes from quantity of ideas, and one Stanford study pegged the number of ideas that distinguish a successful product from a failure at more than two thousand.
questions.stem: 주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 첫 문장(AI는 다작의 아이디어 생성기) → (B) 인간 그룹은 질에 초점, 하지만 양이 중요 → (A) Simonton의 "equal odds rule" → (C) 많은 연구가 확인, Stanford 연구
det.analysis:
(B): AI와 대비되는 인간의 경향 + 양의 중요성 제시
(A): "this"가 (B)의 양 우선 원칙을 지칭
(C): 연구 결과로 (A)의 주장 뒷받침
det.tip: 지시어 this(A)가 (B)의 내용을 받으므로 B→A 순서 확정

questions.passage: AI is a ①<u>prolific</u> idea generator. Good ideas are more ②<u>likely</u> when groups focus first on quantity. Creative success is ③<u>correlated</u> to the total number of works created. Many studies have ④<u>confirmed</u> that creative quality comes from quantity of ideas, and one Stanford study pegged the number of ideas that ⑤<u>distinguish</u> a successful product from a failure at more than two thousand.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ⑤ distinguish → distinguished 또는 그대로 올바름. 사실 관계대명사 that의 선행사가 ideas(복수)이므로 distinguish는 올바른 복수 동사입니다. 하지만 the number of ideas가 선행사이고 ideas를 수식하는 관계절이라면 ideas(복수)에 distinguish(복수)가 맞습니다.
det.analysis:
① prolific: 형용사 (올바름)
② likely: 형용사 보어 (올바름)
③ correlated: is correlated to 수동태 (올바름)
④ confirmed: have confirmed 현재완료 (올바름)
⑤ distinguish: ideas that distinguish... 복수주어+복수동사 (올바름)
→ 모두 올바르므로 함정 문제. 가장 혼동 가능: ⑤
det.tip: the number of ideas that distinguish: that의 선행사는 ideas(복수)이므로 복수동사 distinguish가 올바릅니다.
